title: Numerical analysis of spatiotemporal high-index saddle dynamics for finding multiple solutions of semilinear elliptic problems
summary: This paper presents a rigorous numerical framework for computing multiple solutions of semilinear elliptic problems by spatiotemporal high-index saddle dynamics (HiSD), which extends the traditional HiSD to the continuous-in-space setting, explicitly incorporating spatial differential operators. To enforce the Stiefel manifold constraint without introducing the analytical complications of retraction-based updates, we design a fully discrete retraction-free orthonormality-preserving scheme for spatiotemporal HiSD.
